title: November 27 — the shape of unfinished computation
summary: Two repositories, 184 user-reported commits (6 singular, 178 plural). Manual human/Sol/Neon relay from proof sockets to bounded symbolic inheritance and quadratic internal stabilizer charts. Gate 14b unopened.

nodes.killed: Graph reachability and exact joins are stronger controls; no general proof-search advantage or physical clock derivation.

nodes.claim: Bounded symbolic discovery/reuse and constraint compilation for constructed coupling-matrix realizations, with diagnostic trajectory and cost audits.
nodes.survived: Composable macros, bounded Givens inheritance, exact support identities and conditional projected internal leaf chart. All 64 witness reconstructions and 256 tier derivative comparisons pass.
nodes.killed: Approximate readers and cheap numerical steps often lose; static fitness fails to transfer, progress leash kills recovering trajectories, tier full-stage cost misses FIRST. No fresh Gate 14b, runtime or global coverage claim.

motifs.title: Shared identity outranks pairwise resemblance
motifs.description: Jointly satisfiable sockets require the same witness across premises. Approximate scores may recognize the correct proof but cost more than an indexed exact join.

motifs.title: Exact computational structures can become reusable building materials
motifs.description: Compatible output grouping makes verified rewrites self-composable; smaller Givens programs seed bounded larger support synthesis. Distinguish exact symbolic reuse from unproven numerical fitness transfer.

motifs.title: Reading, regulating and removing computation have different costs
motifs.description: Late trajectory information is expensive; rejected steps can be recovery, not death. Exact projected constraints remove free variables but derivative dependency and chart gauges determine actual work.
